stories.title: Saudi Arabia positions Riyadh as global energy security hub as WPC Energy Congress opens

en.title: Saudi Arabia positions Riyadh as global energy security hub as WPC Energy Congress opens
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Energy Minister stated the kingdom intends to remain central to global energy security while pursuing its long-term strategy. The 25th WPC Energy Congress opened in Riyadh for the first time, running through mid-October.

stories.title: Merih Demiral condemns ‘terrorism’ following tragic Riyadh airport attack

en.title: Merih Demiral condemns 'terrorism' following tragic Riyadh airport attack
en.summary: Turkish footballer Merih Demiral, playing for Al-Ahli Saudi FC, expressed condolences for victims of a Houthi militia attack on Riyadh's airport that killed 12 people and injured over 300, calling it a terrorist attack.

stories.title: New Attack Targets Riyadh Airport; Coalition Intercepts Two Missiles, a Drone

en.title: New Attack Targets Riyadh Airport; Coalition Intercepts Two Missiles, a Drone
en.summary: An attack targeted Riyadh airport, with a coalition intercepting two missiles and a drone during the incident.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia signs energy cooperation deals with Kuwait, Qatar and Egypt

en.title: Saudi Arabia signs energy cooperation deals with Kuwait, Qatar and Egypt
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Energy Minister signed three cooperation agreements with counterparts from Kuwait, Qatar, and Egypt covering electricity, renewable energy, oil, gas, petrochemicals, and energy storage, with provisions for technology exchange and joint projects.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia tracks drone, cruise missile threats as Riyadh airport suspension extended

en.title: Saudi Arabia tracks drone, cruise missile threats as Riyadh airport suspension extended
en.summary: Saudi air defenses destroyed a ballistic missile from Yemen's Houthi militia targeting Khamis Mushayt, while the Arab Coalition tracked additional drone and cruise missile threats against the Kingdom.

stories.title: Pakistani resident killed, 11 injured in Sunday’s attack on Riyadh airport

en.title: Pakistani resident killed, 11 injured in Sunday's attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: One Pakistani resident was killed and 11 others injured in an attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Sunday, with the injured receiving hospital treatment and authorities assessing damage.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia signs pacts for expanding energy cooperation with Kuwait, Qatar and Egypt

en.title: Saudi Arabia signs pacts for expanding energy cooperation with Kuwait, Qatar and Egypt
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Energy Minister signed three memoranda of understanding with Kuwait, Qatar, and Egypt to expand cooperation in electricity, renewable energy, power grid interconnection, and related energy fields.

stories.title: Saudi, Iranian FMs Discuss Regional Tensions as UK, Syria Condemn Houthi Attack

en.title: Saudi, Iranian FMs Discuss Regional Tensions as UK, Syria Condemn Houthi Attack
en.summary: Saudi and Iranian foreign ministers discussed regional tensions. The UK and Syria condemned a Houthi attack.

stories.title: Saudi minister: Riyadh ‘capital of energy security’

en.title: Saudi minister: Riyadh 'capital of energy security'
en.summary: Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman designated Riyadh as the capital of energy security, highlighting the Kingdom's commitment to reliable global energy supplies. He emphasized that Saudi Arabia's position reflects years of investment and dedication across its energy sector.

stories.title: Global condemnation mounts over deadly Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh airport

en.title: Global condemnation mounts over deadly Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport
en.summary: Multiple countries and international organizations condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed 12 people and injured 309 civilians, with the UAE describing it as a violation of Saudi Arabia's sovereignty.

stories.title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, reaffirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia

en.title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, reaffirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Pakistan's Prime Minister condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed 12 people and injured 309 others, reaffirming Pakistan's commitment to Saudi Arabia's security and territorial integrity.

stories.title: Rubio condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, says US stands with Saudi Arabia

en.title: Rubio condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, says US stands with Saudi Arabia
en.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio strongly condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed 12 people, including an American citizen, and stated that the United States supports Saudi Arabia.

en.title: Q3 2026 earnings forecasts: Riyad Capital
en.summary: Riyad Capital released third quarter 2026 profit projections for 40 companies listed on TASI, covering banks, petrochemicals, telecommunications, and software sectors. The forecasts show varied year-over-year changes across different companies and industries.

stories.title: ‎GACA extends suspension of operations at Riyadh international airport

en.title: GACA extends suspension of operations at Riyadh international airport
en.summary: The General Authority of Civil Aviation extended the suspension of operations at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh to complete safety verification procedures. The suspension followed terrorist attacks on Saturday.

en.title: Watani Steel hits 52-week peak
en.summary: Watani Steel shares reached their highest price in 52 weeks on October 12, trading at 2.92 SAR. The stock gained 60% since transferring from the Nomu-Parallel Market to the Main Market last week.

en.title: TASI: 8 stocks, 1 REIT fall to 52-week lows
en.summary: Eight companies listed on TASI and one REIT unit reached their lowest prices in 52 weeks on October 12, with declines ranging from 17% to 73% over the period.

stories.title: ‎TASI: 3 stocks, 1 REIT drop to all-time lows

en.title: TASI: 3 stocks, 1 REIT drop to all-time lows
en.summary: Three TASI-listed companies and one REIT unit declined to their lowest levels since listing on October 12, with performance declines ranging from 15% to 62% year-to-date.
